question_annotated:
Mai jujjuya kwallaye zai iya jujjuya {n, 16} kwallaye. {frac_1_txt,rabi} na kwallayen {ball_type,golf} ne, kuma {frac_2_txt,rabi} na kwallayen {ball_type,golf} suna da launin {color, shuɗi}. Yaushe kwallaye masu launin {color, shuɗi} na {ball_type,golf} akwai?

#init:
- ball_type = sample(["golf", "tennis"])
- color = sample(colors)
- frac_1_txt, frac_1_val = sample(fraction_alnum)
- frac_2_txt, frac_2_val = sample(fraction_alnum)
- $n = range(16, 100, 2)

#conditions:
- is_int(n * frac_1_val)
- is_int(n * frac_1_val * frac_2_val)

#answer:  int(n * frac_1_val * frac_2_val)

Don yin kira daga {dev,wayar gada}, dole ne ka biya {currency,$}{frac1,0.25} ga kowane minti na kiranka. Bayan mintuna {t,16}, wannan farashin yana raguwa zuwa {currency,$}{frac2,0.2} a kowane minti. Nawa ne zai kashe kira na mintuna {total,36}?

#init:
- dev = sample(['phone booth', 'hotel room phone'])
- currency = sample(currencies_sym)
- $frac1 = sample(fraction_decimals)
- $frac2 = sample(fraction_decimals)
- $t = range(10, 50)
- $total = range(36, 100)

#conditions:
- is_int(frac1 * t)
- is_int((total-t) * frac2)
- frac2 < frac1
- t < total

#answer: int((frac1 * t) + frac2*(total-t))

{name, Peter} yana son yin kubu ɗan ƙanƙara masu girma daban-daban ta amfani da {n,32} {unit,gram} na ruwa. Zai iya yin kubu masu girma waɗanda ke amfani da {w1,4} {unit,gram} a kowane cube, kubu na tsakiya waɗanda ke amfani da {w2,2} {unit,gram}, da kubu ƙanana waɗanda ke amfani da {w3,1/2} {unit,gram}. Idan ya yi {n1,3} kubu masu girma, {n2,7} kubu na tsakiya, da {n3,8} kubu ƙanana, me yake da gram nawa na ruwa ya rage?

#init:
- name = sample(names_male)
- unit = sample(["gram", "g"])
- $w1 = range(4, 10)
- $w2 = range(2, 10)
- $w3 = sample(fractions)
- $n1 = range(3, 10)
- $n2 = range(7, 13)
- $n3 = sample([8, 14, 24, 15])
- $n = range(32, 240, 4)

#conditions:
- w3 < w2 < w1
- is_int(n3 * w3)
- n - (n1*w1) - (n2*w2) - int(n3*w3) > 0

#answer: (n - (n1*w1) - (n2*w2) - int(n3*w3))

{name, Sunny} yana sayar da {food,gingerbread} da {fruit,apple} pie don taron taimako. A {d1,Saturday}, ya sayar da {n1,10} akwati na {food,gingerbread} da {m1,4} akwati kaɗan na {fruit,apple} pie, fiye da {d2,Sunday}. A {d2,Sunday}, ya sayar da {n2,5} akwati na {food,gingerbread} fiye da {d1,Saturday} da {m2,15} akwati na {fruit,apple} pie. Idan {food,gingerbread} yana da ƙimar {cur,$}{cn,6} kuma {fruit,apple} pie yana da ƙimar {cur,$}{cm,15}, nawa ne {name,Sunny} ya samu a cikin kwanaki biyu?

#init:
- name = sample(names_male)
- fruit = sample(fruits)
- cur = sample(currencies_sym)
- food = sample(["gingerbread", "cookies", "brownies", "muffins", "cupcakes"])
- d1, d2 = sample_sequential(weekdays, 2)
- $n1 = range(21, 30)
- $n2 = range(11, 15)
- $m1 = range(4, 20)
- $m2 = range(15, 30)
- $cn = range(7, 13)
- $cm = range(20, 33)

#conditions:
- m1 < m2

#answer: (2*n1+n2)*cn + (2*m2-m1)*cm

{name,Raphael} ya tafi siyan kayan makaranta. Ya sayi {n1,4} {obj1,alamomi} waɗanda suka kudi {cur,$}{c1,1.5} kowanne, {n2,2} {obj2,tututun rubutu} waɗanda suka kudi {cur,$}{c2,4} kowanne, da kuma katin bond da ya kudi {cur,$}{c3,20}. Nawa ne {name,Raphael} ya kashe a duk abubuwan?

{name,Frankie} yana kallo talabijin bayan ya kammala aikin gida kowace dare. A {d1,Litinin} da {d2,Talata}, ya kallo {h1,1}-awa shirin shirinsa na kowane dare. A {d3,Laraba}, ya kallo wasu shirye-shiryen na {m1,30}-minti. A {d4,Alhamis}, ya kammala aikin gida da wuri kuma ya kallo {h2,1}-awa shiri da {m2,30}-minti shiri. A {d5,Juma'a}, ya yi iya zama da dare, don haka ya kallo {n2_txt,biyu} {h3,1}-awa shirye-shiryen. Idan ya kallo {total,7} awa na talabijin a duka, nawa {m1,30}-minti shirye-shiryen ya kallo a {d3,Laraba}?

#init:
- name = sample(names_male)
- d1, d2, d3, d4, d5 = sample_sequential(weekdays, 5)
- $total = range(7, 33)
- $h1 = range(1, 7)
- $h3 = range(1, 6)
- $m1 = range(5, 61, 5)
- $m2 = range(5, 61, 5)
- $h2 = range(1, 7)
- n2_txt, n2_val = range_str(2, 5, 1, numbers)

#conditions: 
- divides(m1, 15)
- divides(m2, 15)
- divides(total * 60 - 2* h1 * 60 - h2 * 60 - m2 - n2_val* h3 * 60, m1)
- (total * 60 - 2* h1 * 60 - h2 * 60 - m2 - n2_val* h3 * 60)/m1 > 0
- (total * 60 - 2* h1 * 60 - h2 * 60 - m2 - n2_val* h3 * 60)/m1 < 8 

#answer: int((total * 60 - 2* h1 * 60 - h2 * 60 - m2 - n2_val* h3 * 60)/m1)

A cikin darajar {teacher,Mr. Roper} mai dalibai {total,30}, kashi {p1,20}% na darajar su ne {group1,'yan wasan kwallon kafa}. Daga sauran dalibai, kashi {p2,25}% na dalibai ne {group2,'yan kungiyar taimako} ko na {group3,ƙungiyar kiɗa}. Waɗannan rukunoni uku na dalibai za su buƙaci fita da wuri a yau don tafiya zuwa {event,wasa} a waje. Yaushe dalibai ne za su fita da wuri?

#init:
- teacher = sample(['Ms. Johnson', 'Mr. Smith', 'Dr. Lee', 'Mrs. Garcia'])
- group1 = sample(['yan wasan kwallon kafa', 'yan wasan kwallon kwando', 'yan wasan kwallon ƙwallon ƙafa', 'yan wanki'])
- group2, group3 = sample(['yan rawa', 'mambobin kungiyar murya', 'mambobin ƙungiyar muhawara', 'mambobin ƙungiyar robot'],  2)
- event = sample(['gasar', 'gasar cin kofin', 'wasan kwaikwayo', 'taron'])
- $total = range(20, 150)
- $p1 = range(10, 50)
- $p2 = range(15, 45)

#conditions:
- p1 < 100
- p2 < 100
- is_int(total * p1 / 100)
- is_int((total - total * p1 / 100) * p2 / 100)

#answer: int(total * p1 / 100 + (total - total * p1 / 100) * p2 / 100)

A {facility,hospital} yana da karfin karbar {total,1000} {item,bed}s tare da {frac,1/5} an cika. Saboda {event,coronavirus outbreak}, {daily,50} marasa lafiya ana shigar su cikin {facility,hospital} kowace rana. Lissafa jimlar adadin {item,bed}s da ba a cika a {facility,hospital} bayan {period,2} makonni.

#init:
- facility = sample(["hospital", "clinic", "medical center", "care facility"])
- item = sample(["bed", "room", "ward"])
- event = sample(["flu season", "natural disaster", "major accident", "pandemic"])
- $total = range(500, 2000, 100)
- $frac = sample(fractions)
- $daily = range(20, 100, 5)
- $period = range(2, 5)

#conditions:
- is_int(total * frac)
- total * frac + daily * period * 7 < total

#answer: total - (total * frac + daily * period * 7)

A cikin taron takardun {item,mai sihir}, akwai takardun {c1,ja} {n1,15}, kuma takardun {c2,kore} sun fi haka da kashi {p,60}%. Takardun {c3,rawaya} suna da yawa kamar jimlar takardun {c1,ja} da {c2,kore}. Yawan takardun dukkan launukan da aka ambata guda nawa ne?

- $n1 = range(15, 81)
- $p = range(20, 90)

#conditions:
- p < 100
- is_int(p/100 * n1)

- $n1 = range(5, 15)
